# Advanced-hockey fixtures

Evolving-Hockey and PuckPedia data is licensed to the maintainer personally and never enters git
(ADR 0005). Fixtures here copy the **real column layouts** with **invented values**: made-up
players, teams and numbers, never values copied or derived from a real export.

This is the only folder `script/licensed-data-guard` lets through (ADR 0014), so reviewers check
every file added here by hand.
